title: Tender Acceptance Policy for Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
**Policy.** A card in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program pays for purchases in its type's redemption channels up to its balance, combined with other tenders, never for the purchases its type excludes, and on Northgate Marketplace orders only where its type can pay for Northgate Marketplace orders. A card can be spent only while it is in active status. A Northgate Promotional Gift Card applies only to a purchase of at least its type's smallest purchase for a promotional card, and cannot be combined with another promotional card where its type does not allow more than one promotional card on one purchase. When the balance reaches zero the card becomes depleted.

Cards combine with other tenders where the type allows split tender, need the access number online where the type requires it, and values are kept to the type's rounding. A card may be given to another person where the type allows it, and balances can be checked through the type's balance check channels.

## The active-status condition

- **What decides it.** The card's status in Northgate's own card record decides whether the card can be spent; a customer's description of the card does not.
- **When it is read.** The status is read before the card is charged for the purchase.
- **Which card.** The status read is that of the very card being charged, identified by its card record.

| Card status in the card record | Card can be spent |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| issued (not yet activated) | no |
| frozen | no |
| depleted | no |
| expired | no |
| canceled | no |

## How a card pays (hypothetical amounts)

| Card balance before the purchase | Purchase total | Paid by the card | Paid by other tenders | Card afterwards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20.00 | 50.00 | 20.00 | 30.00 | balance zero, depleted |
| 80.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 0.00 | balance 30.00, active |
| 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 0.00 | balance zero, depleted |

## Promotional card on a purchase

- A purchase total exactly equal to the Northgate Promotional Gift Card's smallest purchase qualifies; a total one cent below it does not.
- With one Northgate Promotional Gift Card already applied to a purchase, a second promotional card cannot be applied to the same purchase.
- A Northgate Promotional Gift Card cannot pay for a Northgate Marketplace order.
